sources.entry: Koha - Enterprise-class ILS with modules for acquisitions, circulation, cataloging, label printing, offline circulation for when Internet access is not available, and much more. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 Perl

summary.one_liner: Koha is a free software integrated library system (ILS) distributed under GPL v3 or later.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short and only states that Koha is a free software integrated library system, distributed under GNU GPL version 3 or later. It notes that the project does not accept pull requests from git hosting sites and has its own bug tracker, with links for reporting bugs, submitting patches, and a developers handbook. The README itself does not describe specific features. The awesome-selfhosted listing describes modules for acquisitions, circulation, cataloging, label printing, and offline circulation for when Internet access is unavailable. The listing also names Perl as the language.
notable: Enterprise-class ILS with acquisitions, circulation and cataloging modules (per awesome-selfhosted listing)
Offline circulation for when Internet access is unavailable (per listing)
caveats: README is minimal and gives no installation or run instructions
Does not accept pull requests from git hosting sites; patches go through its own bug tracker
